content:
q17. web/src/hooks/useMemoQueries.ts; memoServiceClient

- The frontend module `web/src/hooks/useMemoQueries.ts` defines the memo CRUD hooks (queries via `useQuery`/`useInfiniteQuery` and mutations via `useMutation`, e.g. list/get/create/update/delete memo), along with the `memoKeys` cache-key factory (web/src/hooks/useMemoQueries.ts:12).
- It calls the generated Connect-RPC client `memoServiceClient` (imported from `@/connect`, i.e. `web/src/connect.ts:197`), which is created via `createClient(MemoService, transport)` — the generated service client for `MemoService` (backed by `proto/gen/api/v1/apiv1connect/memo_service.connect.go`).
